recognize_zh: 高倍下大部分為無結構、細顆粒並有空泡的壞死物質，中間夾雜波浪狀膠原纖維與少數退化細胞核；這是壞死性肉芽腫的中心區，單看此區無法確認病因，需配合周邊柵欄狀組織球與銀染色。
features: Amorphous, finely granular and vacuolated eosinophilic necrotic material
Wavy bundles of residual collagen within the necrotic zone
Scattered degenerated, smudged nuclei and nuclear debris
No viable granulomatous rim, giant cells or organisms visible in this field
describe_en: High-power H&E shows predominantly amorphous, finely granular and vacuolated necrotic material containing wavy residual collagen bundles and scattered degenerated nuclei and nuclear debris. No viable epithelioid histiocytes, giant cells or organisms are identified in this field. The appearance represents the central necrotic zone of a necrotizing granulomatous process; in isolation it is nonspecific, and correlation with the palisading histiocytic rim, special stains for organisms and clinical history is needed to support cat scratch disease.

ddx.vs: Caseous necrosis is more homogeneous without neutrophilic debris, and acid-fast stains or cultures identify mycobacteria.
Ghost outlines of large atypical cells and viable lymphoma at the periphery, confirmed by IHC, favor necrotic lymphoma.
Kikuchi shows karyorrhectic necrosis with abundant crescentic histiocytes and no neutrophils.
